I am an old woman of 71 years here in Dodoma, and my small piece of land is less than a quarter acre. The rains here are not reliable and the soil is tired, so I cannot waste money on chemical fertilizer or hybrid seeds — I keep my own seed from last harvest and mix the crops together so something will grow even if the rains fail. I put the manure from my few chickens and goats on the plot, and I work it myself with my hoe little by little. My back is not strong anymore, but the plot is small, and I cannot afford to pay anyone to help me.
